title: Pokemon TCG Korean Florges 039/069 s6a Holo Rare Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Florges Pokémon card is a must-have for collectors and fans alike. With a stunning holo finish, this card features the beloved character Florges and is numbered 039/069 in the Korean s6a series. Perfect for those who love the Pokémon Trading Card Game, this card is sure to impress.

Add this card to your collection or use it to strengthen your deck, the possibilities are endless. Don't miss out on the chance to own this rare and unique card.
